title: Pilot who flew the gold out is still alive

tellings.quote: He's still alive. The the commander, the pilot that flew the flew the gold out.

plain: The commander and pilot who flew a load of gold out, in a story set around 1945, is still alive, according to a researcher named Dan Sheehan. Sheehan says this in passing to Jesse Michels and names no source. He does not say where the gold went or why, only that the man who flew it could still speak to what happened.
